lanqiao.cCompiler: Lanqiao C compiler token. Empty uses the current official C choice; unavailable saved choices require selecting again.
lanqiao.cppCompiler: Lanqiao C++ compiler token. Empty uses the official C++17 choice for Lanqiao; unavailable saved choices require selecting again.
description: Read problems, import samples and submit code to Luogu, AtCoder, Codeforces and Nowcoder in BeCoder.
acmMode: Use ACM mode for OJ Connect problem and submission views. Applies to all projects and is saved as a personal setting.
directories: Site subdirectory names for problem detection and imports. Changing names does not move files.
luogu.cCompiler: Luogu C compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice. O2 variants end in :o2.
luogu.cppCompiler: Luogu C++ compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice. O2 variants end in :o2.
atcoder.cCompiler: AtCoder C compiler choice. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Offline choices are checked against the current site catalogue after sign-in. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
atcoder.cppCompiler: AtCoder C++ compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
statementLanguage: Preferred AtCoder statement language. Switching in a problem panel updates this personal setting. Falls back to content the problem actually provides.
panelLocation: Where new problem and submission panels open. Existing panels are not moved.
panelAuto: Automatic: reuse the nearest group to the right of the source, or open beside it.
nowcoder.cCompiler: Nowcoder C compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
nowcoder.cppCompiler: Nowcoder C++ compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
codeforces.cCompiler: Codeforces C compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
codeforces.cppCompiler: Codeforces C++ compiler ID. Choosing in the problem panel or submission picker saves the choice here for all projects. Leave empty for no preference. Unavailable versions require a new choice.
